description: Run every client's 3CX phone system from one CLI: trunk, version, licence and backup health across the whole fleet, plus the full Configuration API on any single PBX.

novel_features.name: Fleet health board
novel_features.description: One row per client phone system with pass, warn, fail or error (unreadable) for version, licence and maintenance expiry, last backup, trunks and extensions registered, disk, stopped services and capacity.

novel_features.name: Fleet trunk board
novel_features.description: Every SIP trunk on every client phone system with state (online, offline, issue, unknown or error), certificate days left and configuration issues, problems first.

novel_features.name: Renewals pipeline
novel_features.description: Licence and maintenance expiry, edition, seat headroom and reseller of record for every client phone system, soonest expiry first.

novel_features.name: Fleet version drift
novel_features.description: Each phone system's 3CX build against the newest build in your fleet, with auto-update state, pending updates and expired maintenance that blocks updates.

novel_features.name: Backup assurance
novel_features.description: Backup age, schedule, rotation and newest backup file for every client phone system, flagged never, stale, unscheduled, no files or shrunk.

novel_features.name: Fleet fan-out query
novel_features.description: Run any read-only Configuration API query on every client phone system and get one merged table with a pbx column; credential fields are redacted and token-minting or download functions are refused.

novel_features.name: Config integrity audit
novel_features.description: Find ring groups, queues, IVRs and inbound rules that route to deleted, disabled or missing extensions, on one phone system or the whole fleet.

novel_features.name: Fleet change feed
novel_features.description: What changed across the fleet between two saved health or trunk runs: trunks offline or back, version bumped, licence renewed, backup gone stale, PBX unreachable.
